info.title: AnsibleForms API v2
info.description: API documentation for AnsibleForms v2 endpoints: authentication, system and health, users, groups and roles, settings, runners, credentials, secret stores, SSO providers, repositories, SSH and known hosts, notification channels, syslog servers, queries and expressions, jobs, stored jobs, schedules and planned runs, the forms designer, announcements, the disclaimer, backups, logs and the audit log.

post.description: Evaluates the expression of a form field. Send formName and fieldName (plus subformName for a field in a subform): the expression text is taken from the form definition, loaded with the caller's roles, and only the placeholder values come from the request. A raw `expression` is accepted only from a user with settings access, or a designer who may edit the forms and sees every form, playbook and workflow (the role options designAllForms, designAllPlaybooks and designAllWorkflows on).

post.summary: Relaunch job by ID, as it ran or with some fields changed
post.description: Without a body the job is replayed with the extravars it ran with. With a body holding `values`, the values the job was launched with are taken, `values` is laid over them, and the result goes through the form engine again - resolved, validated and the extravars built by the server - as a new launch by the caller. Uploads of the original are reused. Without a body, or for a form under launch validation 'enforce', see the Launch validation page : a relaunch that goes through the check is refused (400) for a password field the form shows, since passwords are never stored with the field values ; one its dependencies hide does not count. Only for the job's owner, an admin or a user who sees every job. Needs the form to allow relaunch and the allowJobRelaunch role option.

get.description: Answers 200 while the process runs, for a load balancer or a Kubernetes liveness probe. No authentication.

Answers 200 when the database answers and its schema is complete, 503 otherwise (the process is stopping, the database is unreachable, or the schema is not provisioned or not upgraded). For a load balancer or a Kubernetes readiness probe. No authentication.

The metrics in the Prometheus text format. Only when the METRICS_TOKEN environment variable is set : the request sends it as a bearer token (not a login JWT). Without METRICS_TOKEN the endpoint answers 404.

A server-sent events stream that says what changed, as it changes. It opens with a `hello` event, then sends `changed` events whose data names what changed, e.g. `{"name":"jobs"}` (also `designer` and `appearance`). An event carries a name only, never data : re-read what you show through the normal API. A comment line every 15 seconds keeps the stream open ; reconnect when it closes.

Runs every health check in parallel - database, schema, disk, jobs, scheduler, backups, designer lock, repositories, config seed, Vault, expression sanitizer, LDAP, storage and writable folders - and lists facts about this instance. Side-effect free. Requires settings access.

position.description: the order a bare username is looked up in, the lowest first

domains.description: sign-in domains, comma separated : user@domain goes straight to this directory

server.description: one or more servers, comma separated, each host, host:port or ldap(s)://host:port ; the next one is tried when one cannot be reached. Read : its ldap credential's servers (host). Written : deprecated since 7.3, used only while the credential has none ; port, enable_tls, ignore_certs, cert and ca_bundle the same

credential.description: a credential of Connections > Credentials to bind with instead of bind_user_dn and bind_user_pw

SecretStore.description: A secret store. Which fields are used depends on the type.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: 0 reads the secret on every use

extra.description: JSON object with options of the store type

user.description: Database user (leave empty when using a secret store).

password.description: Database password (leave empty when using a secret store).

host.description: Where it connects : an ssh or a database one's host, an smtp one's mail server, an ldap one's directory servers in failover order (required for smtp and ldap).

secure.description: Use a secure connection (an smtp or an ldap one : TLS).

ignore_certs.description: An ldap credential : the servers' certificates not checked

ca_bundle.description: An ldap credential : the CA bundle its servers' certificates are checked against (its client certificate is client_cert)

used_by_count.description: In the list : how many secret stores, notification channels, repositories, LDAP directories, SSO providers and chat settings use it

credential_type.description: What the credential is for ; is_database follows it

tenant_id.description: An entraid credential's tenant (its user is the client ID, its password the client secret)

issuer.description: An oidc credential's issuer, the provider's address (its user is the client ID, its password the client secret)

redirect_uri.description: An entraid or oidc credential's redirect URL, as registered with its client. Empty : the app's URL setting and the type's callback path (/api/v2/auth/entraid/callback, /api/v2/auth/oidc/callback)

secret_store.description: Name of the secret store user and password are read from.

secret_ref.description: Where the secret lives in the store, e.g. a Vault path.

vault_path.description: Deprecated since 7, removed in 8 : the same as secret_store 'vault' with this secret_ref.

formName.description: Name of the form to launch.

payload.description: The same as extravars, the word a Rundeck job uses ; when both are sent, extravars wins.

job_type.description: Type of job (e.g., ansible, awx, multistep).

OAuth2Provider.description: OAuth2 provider configuration object (Azure AD, OIDC, etc.).

id.description: Unique identifier for the OAuth2 provider.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL. Deprecated since 7.3 : the issuer of its oidc credential, used only while it has no credential.

tenant_id.description: Entra ID tenant ID. Deprecated since 7.3 : the tenant of its entraid credential, used only while it has no credential.

client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID (required unless credential is set).

client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret (required unless credential is set). Use '**********' to preserve existing secret when updating.

credential.description: A credential of Connections > Credentials to sign in as instead: its user is the client ID, its password the client secret.

enable.description: Enable this provider (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled). Only one provider of each type can be enabled.

redirect_uri.description: OAuth2 redirect URI. Deprecated since 7.3 : the redirect URL of its credential, used only while the credential has none.

userinfo_url.description: User info URL (optional, auto-discovered for OIDC).

expiryDays.description: Lifetime in days, at most API_TOKEN_MAX_DAYS; 'never' needs extendedTokenExpiration

blocked.description: true blocks the sign-in, false allows it

description.description: Who the user is or what the account is for

path.description: File path relative to the kind's folder (prefixed with the repository name when there are several roots).

FormsConfigDocument.description: The forms configuration (categories, roles, constants, forms) as an object; a non-admin may not change the roles.

message.description: the text shown (trimmed, cut at 500 characters)

start_at.description: when it starts showing; none : at once

end_at.description: when it stops showing (then it is deleted); after start_at and in the future

one_time_run.description: Run once at run_at instead of on the cron

extra_vars.description: Extra vars as a YAML/JSON string

enabled.description: Off: the cron or one-time run does not fire (launch still works)

planned.description: Create only: plan a one-time run as the calling user (Run later) instead of an admin-level schedule

raw_form_data.description: Create of a planned run only: the raw field values (object or JSON string), checked by launch validation

Schedule.description: Fields owner, state, output, last_run and queue_id are ignored on write.

name.description: Name, unique per user and form

form_data.description: The form values as a JSON string

visibility.description: private (default): only the owner. shared: also the users with the allowStoredJobsViewAll role option, who can load it but not change it

StoredJob.description: Only these fields are written; id, username (always the caller) and created_at are ignored. name, form_name and form_data are required on create.
